name: obsidian-finance
description: Optional SEC evidence acquisition and folder-grounded equities and quarterly market research with source cutoffs and protected checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: SEC evidence, equities and quarterly market research
interface.longDescription: Use sec-data for source-linked SEC acquisition and equity-research to start or continue quarterly research on U.S.-listed companies in managed version-1 equities folders while preserving reports and edits. Use market-research for quarterly Obsidian market studies and their source-linked continuation. Live SEC acquisition uses a genuine contact saved locally after first-use setup. Offline research can reuse existing evidence without a contact. Python 3.11+ and the standard library suffice. Evidence gaps are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Continue research in my designated managed equities folder at my specified assessment cutoff; discover required work, preserve prior reports and edits, and report evidence gaps and conditional horizon judgments.
